description: Dependency updates with the same 7-day cooldown as pnpm-workspace.yaml (minimumReleaseAge), exact versions in package.json and GitHub Actions pinned to commit SHAs with a version comment.

packageRules.description: Wait 7 days after a release before proposing it (npm packages, the pnpm version in packageManager and GitHub Actions alike). Placed after config:best-practices so it overrides the preset's 3-day npm rule; the update types without a release timestamp keep the preset's opt-out.
typescript-eslint declares the TypeScript majors it supports as a peer range; land TypeScript majors together with it.
